What's new

- Multi-page TIFF files open as pages: the header shows PAGE 2 / 3 and the arrow keys or Page Up / Page Down move through the document.
- Single-page images behave exactly as before - no pager appears.
- Animated GIF playback is coming next.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.21 - multipage TIFF (1E, part 1). WicDecoder accepts a frame index and reports frame counts; TIFF pages navigate with arrows/PageUp/PageDown/Space, clamp at both ends, and show PAGE n / m in the badge. Still images keep the -1 page diagnostic so no pager appears. 9 new checks.
